question: What does Dolby's decoder draw where a mantissa has no bits; can this decoder draw the same; and what is then left between the two decodes?
method: A mantissa without bits takes a random value when its channel asks for dither (ATSC A/52 clause 7.3.4) and the standard leaves the sequence to the decoder. Dolby's decoder writes the same bytes every time it decodes a stream, so what it draws can be read off what it writes. The decoder was run as it stands (`gst-launch-1.0 filesrc ! dlbac3parse ! dlbac3dec out-ch-config=<0, 7 or 11> drc-suppress=true drc-mode=custom-0 drc-cut=0 drc-boost=0 drop-delay=true ! audio/x-raw,format=F32LE ! filesink` of Dolby Reference Player 3.2, `docs/dolby-tools.md`); nothing of it was opened, and only its output was read. First on a stream written for the purpose: `oadec-synth` writes an AC-3 stream of two channels in which no mantissa has a bit, every exponent is 8 and every block asks for dither (`cargo run -p oadec-synth --example dither_probe`), so that a decode of it is the dither and nothing else. `tools/dither_probe.py read` takes the decode back through the transform (windowed overlap-add makes that exact) and says how fine the values are, when the run of them closes, the rule their ranks follow, which generator of 16 bits gives every block of every channel as a run, and the state each block starts from. The same stream was written with 73 and with 133 coefficients a channel and with the dither flag of one channel clear. Then on real streams, where Dolby's decode less this decoder's decode without dither is Dolby's dither alone: a copy of this decoder that wrote down, for every block, which coefficients had no bits, their exponents and the coupling coordinates gave the values over their scale, and the state that gives a run of values was looked for among all 65 536. That is how the coupled states (an AC-3 stream of two coupled channels), the seed of a frame of an independent E-AC-3 substream (the states of eight frames against the 16-bit word at every bit offset of the frame) and the rule of the adaptive hybrid transform were read. The rule was then put into the decoder and held against Dolby's decode: the streams of the corpus (a minute of each), the clips of the media suite, the objects of the gate clips and of the tracks of a library (`tools/joc_bands.py`, forty seconds of each, with the dither on), and one source encoded twice by FFmpeg, as AC-3 and as E-AC-3. The corpus was decoded by the binary of main and by the binary of the change (`tools/old_new.py --decode-all`). A track of the library is a number; the films are not in the repository.
commands: cargo run --release -p oadec-synth --example dither_probe -- probe.ac3   (and: probe.ac3 60 133 73, probe.ac3 60 253 253 10)

gst-launch-1.0 filesrc location=probe.ac3 ! dlbac3parse ! dlbac3dec out-ch-config=0 drc-suppress=true drc-mode=custom-0 drc-cut=0 drc-boost=0 drop-delay=true ! audio/x-raw,format=F32LE ! filesink location=probe.f32
python tools/band_compare.py <oadec decode>.wav <dolby>.f32 --channels <n>   (the bands of the corpus; here with the lag known, 256 samples, since noise gives a lag search nothing to hold)
python tools/joc_bands.py <ours>.atmos.audio <dolby>.f32   (every gate clip and every track, before and after)
OADEC_MEDIA=<work> cargo test --release --locked -p oadec-cli --test real -- --ignored the_dither_is the_objects_are a_hybrid_transform
python tools/mutants.py --only <the mutations of the files the change touches>
OADEC_CAMPAIGN_ITERS=200000 cargo test --release --locked -p oadec-fuzz --test campaign -- the_commands_agree_on_every_changed_stream   (on main and on the change)

main.name: oadec-gain-2.exe

the_stream_without_a_bit.what_it_says: whole numbers of 2^-15, spread as a sum of two; the run closes after 16 384 values and two readings of a place differ by 23 170 or not at all; the ranks of the values modulo that go q -> 9081 q + 8719 modulo 16 384; of the generators of 16 bits the rule allows one gives every block of every channel as a run, x -> x * 47989 + 3 with a value of (((a >> 1) + (b >> 1)) * 23170) >> 15; the blocks of the first frame start 12, 14, 22, 24 ... steps of g -> g * 47989 + 1 from 0, and a block is as many values on one frame later as its channel has coefficients

narrower_channels_and_one_channel_withou.what: the same stream with 133 and 73 coefficients, with 73 and 73, and with the dither flag of either channel clear, 60 frames each, decoded by Dolby's decoder and by the change
narrower_channels_and_one_channel_withou.the_channel_that_does_not_ask: silent in both decodes, and the other channel the same samples as when both ask

the_coupled_states.stream: AC-3, two channels, coupling and rematrixing (the clip `ac3-20-coupled` of the media suite)
the_coupled_states.what: in the blocks of the first frames, the coefficients of the coupling channel without bits give, for each coupled channel, a run of 36 values of the generator, exact to the whole number, from the state one step of the seed generator after the channel's own; the channel's own state does not move for them

the_seed_of_a_frame.stream: E-AC-3, 5.1, an independent substream alone (the clip `eac3-51-plain`)
the_seed_of_a_frame.what: within a frame every block of every channel starts one step of the seed generator after the one before, block by block and channel by channel; between frames the chain jumps. The state before the first of a frame is the 16-bit word that ends 18 bits before the end of the frame: of every bit offset from the start or the end of the frame, of this frame, the one before and the one after, that one alone fits the eight frames tried
the_seed_of_a_frame.the_words: in every stream of the corpus whose independent substream is E-AC-3 a word that changes from frame to frame, and in most of them the same run of words from the first frame on (17f4 150a b7ab e15e 1d75 bedb); in the dependent substreams nought in most frames; in a stream of FFmpeg's encoder nought
the_seed_of_a_frame.the_coupled_states_of_such_a_frame: a stream of two coupled channels: the coupled runs of blocks 1 to 4 of the first frame start 36, 37, 41, 42, 46, 47, 51 and 52 steps after the word, which is 30 after the own state of the same block and channel

the_committed_encode.what: in the second and the third frame every block of every channel whose coefficients without bits could be read starts 5 * block + channel + 1 steps after the word of its frame; the centre, which the scene leaves silent, gives whole numbers, and four runs of them are the numbers of the test `the_dither_of_a_frame_is_the_one_dolbys_decoder_draws_for_it`

a share of the same coefficient of the block before

In that band of the first a few transients carry the whole difference of the two channels (the ten worst of 2478 windows of 2048 samples hold 0,99 of it or more), and the figure is the luck of the run of the noise, before the change as after it

The worst object of `fifthelement-joc-head` is silent for 92 % of the clip and stands at -114 dBFS

reading: Dolby's decoder draws its dither from a generator of 16 bits, x -> x * 47989 + 3, two draws a value, with a state for each block of a frame and each channel and a second one for the coefficients the channel takes from the coupling channel; in an AC-3 stream and in a dependent substream the states go on from frame to frame, and a frame of an independent E-AC-3 substream seeds them from the 16 bits before its auxdatae. Of the 64 generators the measured rule allows, one gives all 474 blocks of Dolby's decode of a stream without a bit as runs. With the same in this decoder, that stream decodes to Dolby's samples to the rounding of a 32-bit float; over 45 streams of the corpus the band from 12 to 18 kHz stands at 77.2 to 107.8 dB from Dolby's where it stood at -3.0 to 31.4; and over 127 tracks of a library the objects stand at 104.2 dB over the whole band at the median where they stood at 52.3, with 0 of 1080 objects further from Dolby's than it was. At the median of its channels no stream of the corpus is further from Dolby's in any band. What is left is not the dither: in the coupled region of an E-AC-3 stream Dolby's decode has something its decode of the same source as AC-3 has not, which neither this decoder nor FFmpeg's makes and which was under the dither of two decoders until now.
